skills.name: seomatic-client-report
skills.description: Use when the user asks for a client report, monthly SEO report, agency report, or an update for their boss.
skills.content:
---
name: seomatic-client-report
description: >-
  Use when the user asks for a client report, monthly SEO report, agency report,
  or an update for their boss.
---
A report a client reads in two minutes and trusts. Outcome first, then the work, then the plan. Every number comes from a SEOmatic tool, with its date range.
Prerequisite: Search Console connected; otherwise send https://app.seomatic.ai/connect/gsc and stop. With several sites, confirm which one.
1. Headline numbers: gsc_performance compare_periods (month vs prior, 28d default); gsc_insights seasonality (say if the change is seasonal); gsc_insights brand_split (non-brand clicks separately); GA4 traffic_analytics overview/sources/landing_pages if connected.
2. What we did and did it work: task_manage list with status verified, ineffective, regressed, inconclusive, in_progress/verifying. For each change: page, change, measured result. Report failures too.
3. AI search: visibility per engine vs previous scan and ai_citations observed_citations. Skip if no scan exists.
4. Next month: strategy_insights strategy and task_manage list status proposed. Three priorities with one-line reasons.
Format: title with site and exact dates; one-sentence summary; results table (clicks, non-brand, impressions, avg position: this month, last month, change); what we changed (N) with measured results or 'still measuring until <date>'; AI search per engine; next month 1-3; waiting on you: N changes to approve.
Plain words. Never take credit the data doesn't attribute, never hide a bad month, never round in the flattering direction.

skills.name: seomatic-seo-audit
skills.description: Use when the user asks for an SEO audit or a health check of the SEOmatic-connected site.
skills.content:
---
name: seomatic-seo-audit
description: >-
  Use when the user asks for an SEO audit or a health check of the
  SEOmatic-connected site.
---
Run an SEO audit with SEOmatic; every read is free and tools are scoped to the connected workspace, so never ask for the domain.
1. Baseline: gsc_performance 28d vs prior period.
2. Diagnosis: gsc_insights for cannibalization, CTR outliers, seasonality, sitemap health.
3. Index health: gsc_indexing batch-inspect the top pages.
4. Technical: site_audit; state crawl coverage honestly.
5. AI search: ai_citations scan_results (free); only offer a fresh paid scan if wanted.
6. Synthesize a ranked list, quick wins first, quantified with GSC numbers.
7. Offer to stage each fix via task_manage create; the user approves every change.
Report only what tools returned.

skills.name: seomatic-traffic-drop
skills.description: Use when the user says traffic, clicks or rankings fell: diagnoses the drop from real Search Console data via SEOmatic.
skills.content:
---
name: seomatic-traffic-drop
description: >-
  Use when the user says traffic, clicks or rankings fell: diagnoses the drop
  from real Search Console data via SEOmatic.
---
Find which cause explains the drop, with numbers, before touching a page. Search Console must be connected; otherwise send https://app.seomatic.ai/connect/gsc and stop.
1. Confirm it's real: gsc_insights seasonality, then gsc_performance compare_periods and trend to find the start day. Drops in the last 48h are provisional.
2. Where clicks went: folder_rollup, top 10 losing pages and queries, serp_competitors features when position held.
3. Technical: gsc_indexing batch_inspect losers, gsc_insights sitemaps, site_pages crawl the biggest losers.
4. Measurement: compare with GA4 traffic_analytics sources if connected.
5. One-sentence verdict with evidence, then fixes ranked by clicks recovered.
Offer to stage up to 5 tasks with task_manage (check list first). Never approve on the user's behalf, don't blame a Google update without evidence, don't call a seasonal dip a drop, don't invent numbers.

skills.content:
---
name: agency-reporter-getting-started
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation of an Agency Reporter bot imported from the
  template.
---
I write the monthly SEO report for each client from real Search Console data.
Ask one thing at a time:
1. Connect SEOmatic (https://app.seomatic.ai/api/mcp, Streamable HTTP, OAuth) if it isn't; if Search Console isn't connected in SEOmatic, send https://app.seomatic.ai/connect/gsc.
2. Confirm the owner's timezone and save it as a memory.
3. Make sure the Monthly client report routine exists (2nd of the month, 9:00 their time), then run it once now with the seomatic-client-report skill and deliver the report.

routines.name: Monthly client report
routines.description: Fires on the 2nd of each month at 9:00 to write last month's client SEO report.
routines.content:
Write last month's SEO report for the connected client workspace with SEOmatic: headline numbers against the month before (exact dates, non-brand clicks separately, seasonality checked), what was changed and the measured result of each, AI search visibility, and three priorities for next month. Use the format in the seomatic-client-report skill.

Fires on:
- cron `0 9 2 * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
